baseline.package_release: success; archive SHA256 verified; all three anonymous image pulls passed
baseline.interpretation: The commit changed chart/GitOps/CI inputs but no service image inputs. The old workflow still published all three images, demonstrating avoidable builds.

implementation.gate: build-and-push requires all quality jobs and image-inputs.build_images == true on main push
implementation.artifact_transport: one digest JSON per service, merged by package-release

local_verification.npm_test: passed; integration tests skipped unless RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS is enabled

branch_run.reason_for_missing_base: First push creating the branch has all-zero before SHA; full history cannot contain that object.
branch_run.publisher: skipped because event was not a main push

branch_evidence_update_run.cause: CP14 evidence JSON was edited after the last Prettier run.
branch_evidence_update_run.resolution: Formatted the evidence JSON and reran full CI.
branch_evidence_update_run.reason_for_missing_base: The preceding branch commit had been force-updated and was no longer fetched as a reachable ref.
branch_evidence_update_run.publisher: skipped because event was not a main push

troubleshooting.symptom: Workflow graph test expected deploy to directly need the image matrix
troubleshooting.cause: The actual dependency is transitive through package-release
troubleshooting.resolution: Asserted image matrix -> package-release -> deploy, matching the actual workflow

troubleshooting.symptom: Prettier reported workflow and lesson formatting
troubleshooting.cause: New YAML list wrapping and Markdown table formatting did not match repository style
troubleshooting.resolution: Formatted the two files and reran repository-wide format check

troubleshooting.symptom: Repository-wide format check failed on the CP14 JSON evidence file.
troubleshooting.cause: Evidence was updated after the previous format check.
troubleshooting.resolution: Ran Prettier on the evidence file; a new full CI run is required.

limitations: The classifier deliberately builds all three images when any app image input changes; per-service selective builds are deferred to avoid a more complex artifact matrix.
The CP13 baseline digest evidence comes from a real GitHub main release artifact; CP14 delivery remains paused and does not deploy those images.
